title: Chapter 180: Superiority In Iq
content:
Chapter 180: Superiority In Iq

Light catapults are not suitable for long-distance transportation, but they can be disassembled into several large parts.

At this time, the soldiers of the crossbow battalion were assembling catapults and setting up bronze crossbow carts.

This time, Wang Shuo brought a total of 2 catapults and 10 crossbow carts, and the long-range attack capability can be said to be unprecedentedly strong.

When everything was ready, Li Jianguo looked at Wang Shuo and asked, "Lord, can we attack?"

Wang Shuo glanced at Zou Yuanjie beside him.

At this time, he was wearing clean new clothes, with long hair tied up on his head. Although his face was still pale, his eyes were bright and he looked much more energetic.

In his hand, he was holding a feather fan that he didn't know where he got from. Although the weather was still a little cold, he kept shaking the fan from time to time.

Wang Shuo wanted to laugh when he saw him like this.

This guy, is he trying to imitate someone?

Seeing Wang Shuo staring at him, Zou Yuanjie understood and immediately used his skill - "High morale".

Increased the morale and attack power of the surrounding troops by 10 points.

Wang Shuo looked up again, glanced at Fengze Village from a distance, and nodded.

"Attack."

Two projectiles streaked through the sky and landed on the opponent's wall.

"Bang, bang!"

After two loud noises, the wall on the opposite side collapsed like tofu dregs, revealing the true appearance of the territory.

When Zhao Tianze saw the catapult, he felt something was wrong. The opponent was well prepared!

He searched carefully in the opponent's army again, and finally found a figure that made him want to crush his bones and ash - Wang Shuo.

Before he had time to curse, the opponent directly blew down his wall.

This time, Zhao Tianze was stunned!

The corner of his mouth twitched, but he didn't make a sound.

The catapult's firing speed was very slow, and the interval between them was generally 2 minutes, which gave Zhao Tianze time to react.

"Enemy attack, all soldiers, assemble!" He was in a panic, but he still shouted loudly.

He couldn't run away this time. It was not easy to develop to this point. He couldn't bear to give up this family business.

Moreover, after a brief panic, he was actually a little happy.

He was fighting on his own land, and the enemy was only relying on catapults to show off their power. His army was several times larger than his, so he was not afraid of anything!

Although he lost 400 archers.

But he still had 200 shield soldiers, 150 archers, 200 sword soldiers, and 300 reserve militia.

He believed that force was supreme, so he focused on developing military power.

If there were not enough living supplies, then go and rob them.

After the second round of attacks, Zhao Tianze's troops had also assembled.

At this time, he showed a wicked smile at the corner of his mouth. His number was several times that of the enemy, and they dared to attack his territory. It was simply ignorant of life and death.

Last time, he was careless for a while and was fooled.

Thinking of this, Zhao Tianze suddenly woke up.

It seems that the opponent has another cavalry unit that has not appeared.

He broke out in a cold sweat, completely overturning his previous fantasy.

He must not go out, this must be Wang Shuo's trick.

"Fuck, old bitch!"

He patted his chest, and a sense of superiority in IQ arose spontaneously!

"Humph, little guy, I have seen through your tricks!" Zhao Tianze showed a contemptuous look.

"Hey, I just don't attack, hey, I'm just playing!" He muttered smugly.

But the soldiers he gathered were a little confused.

Is this Zhao Tianze crazy?

In the face of the enemy, he is performing a face-changing here?

And he is still talking and laughing, but he doesn't order an attack!

What's going on?

A leading soldier, plucked up his courage, whispered: "Lord, don't we fight back?"

Zhao Tianze looked at the centurion he promoted with an idiotic look, and cursed: "Fight back, fight back your mother!"

"Don't you see, this is the other party's conspiracy!"

The centurion was scolded and felt a little uncomfortable, but he didn't dare to say anything.

The hundreds of soldiers who gathered were also staring at each other, at a loss.

The catapult continued to attack. At this time, a large part of the wall had collapsed, and the lord's mansion was hit by a projectile, and a corner was blown up.

Wang Shuo was not in a hurry at this time. This could be said to be an open conspiracy.

It seemed like a suspicious attack, but it was indeed an ambush.

It depends on how Zhao Tianze deals with it.
